visualCharacteristics.layout: 2 columns within ~75% centered width, red caption bar overlapping bottom of greyscale photo, white bold title, whole tile clickable

contentPattern: One row per tile: cell 1 = image; cell 2 = H4 (or paragraph) containing link to /en/about and /en/careers respectively.

options.label: Related links
options.description: Black caption bar, centred titles, 4:3 tiles 4 per row in a centred 75% column (1 / 2 / 4 per row at <520 / 520-959 / >=960px); description (2nd paragraph) hidden, revealed on hover from 720px. Source: www.cp.com/en/about 'Related links' generated list.

options.label: List
options.description: Black caption bar, left-aligned titles, 4:3 tiles 3 per row at full section width (use with section style 'wide'; 1 / 2 / 3 per row at <520 / 520-959 / >=960px); description hidden, revealed on hover from 720px. Source: www.cp.com/en/about/sustainability 'More on sustainability' generated list.

options.label: Gallery
options.description: Full-bleed photo masonry with unlinked H6 captions in the red bar. 9-tile rhythm: tiles 9n+1, 9n+5, 9n+7 are wide (2:1, span 2 columns), the rest square; 1 column (<720), 2 columns (720-1139; all square 960-1139), 4 columns (>=1140). A tile whose body is only a YouTube/Vimeo link becomes a video tile (play icon, opens the video in a dialog). Source: www.cp.com/en/about/our-legacy .card-overview.
